data.description:
# Bug: skill_path fails in bash

Agents paste code blocks containing $(skill_path report)/scripts/... into bash.
bash expands $(skill_path report) trying to run skill_path as a command → "command not found".

skill_path is a Pi tool, not a shell command. The convention introduced in commit 0d23a44 says 
"$(skill_path <name>)/scripts/..." is "resolved at runtime via the skill_path tool" — but 
most SKILL.md files don't make this explicit.

## Affected skills

All 15 SKILL.md files use $(skill_path <name>)/scripts/... in bash code blocks:
- report/SKILL.md (canonical embed block)
- plan, implement, audit, cleanup, test, triage, refactor, resolve-pr-comments, author-command, ship, intake

## Acceptance Criteria

1. $(skill_path <name>) resolves correctly in bash from any project CWD — via a skill_path shell shim at ~/.pi/agent/bin/skill_path
2. Report skill's canonical embed block includes explicit Path Resolution instructions
3. All 15 SKILL.md files pass tests/test_skill_path_conventions.py
4. Full test suite passes
5. tree_coverage.py import fix is committed
data.title: Plan skill: $(skill_path report) fails in bash — skill_path is a Pi tool, not a shell command
